description: From the Pentagon up through Rosslyn and the hills of Langston Boulevard and Spout Run, over the Key Bridge to Georgetown, out and back on Rock Creek Parkway, around Hains Point, along the National Mall to the Capitol, back over the 14th Street Bridge to the Pentagon and Crystal City, and an uphill finish at the Marine Corps War Memorial. Unofficial.

source.notes: 2026 course, the certified course DC25002LMJ (valid to 2035), as on the organiser's certified course map and 2026 event map: Route 110, N Lynn St, Langston Blvd, Spout Run Pkwy, the Key Bridge, M St, Wisconsin Ave and K St in Georgetown, Rock Creek Pkwy out to Shoreham Dr and back, Ohio Dr, Hains Point, Independence Ave, the National Mall (Madison and Jefferson Drives) to the Capitol, the 14th Street Bridge, the Pentagon, Crystal Dr to 2121 Crystal Drive and back, Long Bridge Dr, Boundary Dr, Route 110 and up to the Marine Corps War Memorial. Route traced over OpenStreetMap streets; distances calibrated to the two turnarounds (interpolated from the map's mile markers) and the finish. The loop around the Pentagon's "Pork Chop" lot (miles 21–22) isn't traceable in OpenStreetMap, so the traced course is about 1.8 km short there and the flat middle of the course is stretched to fit. Elevations from USGS 3DEP lidar (northern Virginia 2022, Fairfax County 2018, National Capital Region 2014); bridges interpolated. Unofficial.
